description: This Java class 'DefaultCircuitBreakerConfig' provides a default implementation of the 'CircuitBreakerConfig' interface, encapsulating configuration settings related to circuit breaker functionality, including maximum failures and timeout configurations. It includes methods to instantiate configurations from external Config objects, and overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultCircuitBreakerConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing 'CircuitBreakerConfig' interface, managing circuit breaker settings including max failures and timeouts.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new 'DefaultCircuitBreakerConfig' instance based on the provided Config object.

methods.name: getMaxFailures
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of failures before the circuit breaker trips.

methods.name: getTimeoutConfig
methods.description: Returns the timeout configuration associated with the circuit breaker.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString to provide a string representation of the configuration.
